programme.title: SkywatchTV - Are American Jesuits Running The USA
programme.desc: What if some of the most influential chapters of American history have been largely forgotten—or intentionally overlooked In Part 1 of this fascinating three-part series Joe Horn welcomes award-winning filmmaker and historian Chris Pinto to discuss his latest documentary American Jesuits A History of Jesuitism in the United States Together they examine the origins of the Jesuit Order the Counter-Reformation and the historical events that led to the Society of Jesuits becoming one of the most influential organizations in the world They also explore why many early Protestant leaders viewed the Jesuits with deep concern and how those beliefs shaped discussions about religion and government in early America In this episode youll discover • The origins of the Jesuit Order and its founding mission • How the Protestant Reformation led to the Counter-Reformation • Why the Jesuits became one of historys most influential religious orders • The historical context behind early Protestant concerns about Jesuit influence • Why Chris Pinto believes recovering forgotten history matters today Whether youre interested in church history American history or the forces that have shaped Western civilization this conversation offers a thought-provoking look at events that continue to spark debate centuries later
